features.name: See item count and total value
features.match_note: No counts or value totals; value tracking is out of scope (R103).

features.name: Browse the item list
features.match_note: Items are reached by search, tags and places; no rule defines a list of every item.

features.name: Search items by name or tag
features.match_note: Search by name and tag, including sub-tags.

features.name: Scan a barcode to find an item
features.match_note: No product barcodes; QR codes on Chatelaine's labels open places only.

features.name: Sort items by expiry or date
features.match_note: An expiring-soon view exists; no list sorting is defined.

features.name: Switch to a compact list
features.match_note: Density is set per screen; no user toggle.

features.name: Add an item with amount and tags
features.match_note: Name, quantity, tags and notes.

features.name: Change an item's amount by one
features.match_note: − and + only for Pantry items counted in pieces or packs.

features.name: Set an expiry date
features.match_note: Expiry date preset, typed or read from a label.

features.name: Set a low-stock threshold
features.match_note: Minimum stock, for Pantry items only.

features.name: Record a price on an item
features.match_note: Shop prices live in Shopping's price book by store and date; no plain price field.

features.name: Attach a barcode to an item
features.match_note: No barcode field or scan.

features.name: Add photos from camera or gallery
features.match_note: Camera photos on items; picking an existing photo is not stated.

features.name: Delete an item after confirming
features.match_note: Deleting an item is mentioned only in passing; no rule defines it.

features.name: Duplicate an item
features.match_note: An item with a quantity can be split into separate items; no duplicate action.

features.name: See an item's stock movements
features.match_note: Stock changes feed the usage rate and ticks add purchases; no movement history view.

features.name: Log an item's usage
features.match_note: Pantry stock is lowered in its counting unit; no separate usage record.

features.name: Log a purchase
features.match_note: Ticking as bought in Shopping raises the quantity and records a receipt.

features.name: Log maintenance
features.match_note: No rule defines maintenance records.

features.name: Set a dated reminder on an item
features.match_note: Only the fixed notifications of R99; no free dated reminder.

features.name: Make a checklist of items
features.match_note: A project tag gathers items for a purpose; no checklist with its own ticks.

features.name: Export and import data
features.match_note: Manual export and import of JSON and photos.

features.name: Choose a theme
features.match_note: No theme setting.

features.name: Get expiry alerts within a set window
features.match_note: Opt-in expiry notifications; no warning-window setting.

features.name: Get low-stock alerts
features.match_note: Opt-in, for Pantry items.

features.name: Back up automatically on an interval
features.match_note: Automatic backup to a chosen folder; the interval is not specified.
